properties.name: The answered-question debt line says only what its computation can support — on all seven surfaces that repeated the claim
properties.rationale:
THE CAUSE, written down because the repair is recoverable from the diff and the cause is not: the message was authored by hand alongside a counter it did not match, and nothing checks a reflow2 sentence against the behaviour it describes. That is why it shipped, why a passing test locked it in, and why three independent sessions each re-diagnosed it from scratch — reflow2's own orientation call 2026-08-16, the StoryFlow fleet, and proj:chama on 2026-09-02, seventeen days after the cause was recorded here and findable by its own error string.

LABELLED `defect_fix` RATHER THAN `documentation` DELIBERATELY. The tool's own test is behavioural: a normative sentence that changes what somebody DOES takes a real label. This one prescribed two remedies and agents acted on them — chama followed the prescription and was told to undo correct work — so it was behaviour, not prose about behaviour.

⚠️ WHAT THIS DOES NOT FIX, stated so it is not read as closed: the loop still cannot tell a DEFERRED answer from a genuinely unwritten one. It now declines to guess instead of guessing wrong, which is strictly better and strictly less useful than option B or C of the decision this implements. Making the fact computable needs a typed edge from a design record onto a Question, which does not exist — measured 2026-09-02: `describe_schema{Decision, Question}` returns zero exact and zero half-exact matches.

⚠️ CONSUMER-VISIBLE BREAK, flagged rather than buried: `unwritten_answers` was a served field in the loop_status JSON. Renaming it is judged correct here because the NAME was itself the false claim and reflow2 is pre-1.0, where `rule:fix-it-properly-while-it-is-still-cheap` says break consumers now rather than deprecate. The counter-precedent was weighed and rejected: heal.rs deliberately did NOT rename `unthreaded_cluster` because "renaming it to be accurate would break them to fix a sentence" — different, because that name was merely imprecise while this one asserted something untrue.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary:
`loop_status` said "N answered question(s) never reached the design — write the answer in, or acknowledge the gap" from a count that knows only that a question is answered and its gap is still open. Nothing looked for the answer among the design's nodes. Both prescribed remedies were wrong for the commonest case — a deferral the genesis skill itself prescribes, recorded as an open Decision, whose gap is legitimately open.

FIXED ON EVERY SURFACE THAT REPEATED THE CLAIM, because repairing only the one reported line would have fixed the instance and left the class: the `LoopStatus.answered_with_open_gap` field (renamed from `unwritten_answers`, whose NAME asserted the unreachable half), its doc comment, the `next` message, the scoped `not_attributable` label, `service.rs`'s read-side nudge label ("answer(s) not written back"), `tools/graph_probe.py`'s probed key, and `tools/loop_nudge.py`'s Stop-hook sentence ("answer(s) the user gave that nothing has written into the design").

The new line: "N answered question(s) still have an open gap — that is all this knows, and it is not a claim the answer went unwritten: read them (open_questions), then write in what is missing or leave a gap that is genuinely blocked."

PINNED BY A TEST THAT WAS OBSERVED TO FAIL FIRST. `an_answered_questions_line_claims_only_what_the_count_can_know` builds the state the genesis skill prescribes — question answered "not sure", the deferral recorded as an open Decision so the answer DID reach the design, gap still legitimately open — and asserts the line makes no claim about design nodes. Against the unfixed code it failed with the false sentence quoted verbatim. It pins the CLASS: no `next` line may assert a fact its computation cannot reach.

⚠️ AND THE OLD TEST WAS PART OF THE DEFECT: `tests/report.rs` asserted `l.contains("never reached the design")` under the comment "An answer that never reaches the design is its own named debt." The false claim was pinned in place by a passing check, which is why it survived seventeen days of green builds.

Workspace green (cargo test --workspace, exit 0; the 20 report tests confirmed by name) and 91 Python nudge tests pass against the renamed key.
